ROOT.triggerdef:
Create Trigger CDN.TraNag_InitFields on CDN.TraNag for insert as Begin
update T set t.TrN_SpiTyp = t.TrN_GIDTyp, t.TrN_SpiFirma = t.TrN_GIDFirma , t.TrN_SpiNumer = t.TrN_GIDNumer , t.TrN_SpiLp = t.TrN_GIDLp From CDN.TraNag T join inserted on t.TrN_GIDTyp = inserted.TRN_GIDTyp and t.TrN_GIDNumer = inserted.TRN_GIDNumer and t.TrN_GIDLp = inserted.TRN_GIDLp Where SIGN(inserted.TrN_GIDTyp & 0x100) <>0 AND inserted.TrN_SpiTyp = inserted.TrN_GIDTyp
update T set t.TrN_ZwrTyp = t.TrN_GIDTyp, t.TrN_ZwrFirma = t.TrN_GIDFirma , t.TrN_ZwrNumer = t.TrN_GIDNumer , t.TrN_ZwrLp = t.TrN_GIDLp From CDN.TraNag T join inserted on t.TrN_GIDTyp = inserted.TRN_GIDTyp and t.TrN_GIDNumer = inserted.TRN_GIDNumer and t.TrN_GIDLp = inserted.TRN_GIDLp Where SIGN(inserted.TrN_GIDTyp & 0x100)<>0 and inserted.TrN_ZwrTyp = inserted.TrN_GIDTyp and inserted.TrN_ZwrFirma=0 and inserted.TrN_ZwrNumer= 0
End
